+"""Request handlers."""
+
+from fractions import Fraction
+
+from app.services import users
+
+_MAX_EXPR_LENGTH = 100
+
+
+class _InvalidExpression(Exception):
+    """Raised when a string is not a valid arithmetic expression."""
+
+
+def _tokenize(expr: str) -> list[str]:
+    """Split an expression into number, operator and parenthesis tokens."""
+    tokens: list[str] = []
+    i = 0
+    length = len(expr)
+    while i < length:
+        ch = expr[i]
+        if ch.isspace():
+            i += 1
+        elif "0" <= ch <= "9":
+            j = i
+            while j < length and "0" <= expr[j] <= "9":
+                j += 1
+            tokens.append(expr[i:j])
+            i = j
+        elif ch in "+-*/()":
+            tokens.append(ch)
+            i += 1
+        else:
+            raise _InvalidExpression
+    return tokens
+
+
+class _Parser:
+    """Recursive-descent parser and evaluator for arithmetic expressions."""
+
+    def __init__(self, tokens: list[str]) -> None:
+        self._tokens = tokens
+        self._pos = 0
+        self.division_by_zero = False
+
+    def _peek(self) -> str | None:
+        if self._pos < len(self._tokens):
+            return self._tokens[self._pos]
+        return None
+
+    def _advance(self) -> None:
+        self._pos += 1
+
+    def parse(self) -> Fraction:
+        value = self._expr()
+        if self._pos != len(self._tokens):
+            raise _InvalidExpression
+        return value
+
+    def _expr(self) -> Fraction:
+        value = self._term()
+        while True:
+            token = self._peek()
+            if token == "+":
+                self._advance()
+                value += self._term()
+            elif token == "-":
+                self._advance()
+                value -= self._term()
+            else:
+                return value
+
+    def _term(self) -> Fraction:
+        value = self._factor()
+        while True:
+            token = self._peek()
+            if token == "*":
+                self._advance()
+                value *= self._factor()
+            elif token == "/":
+                self._advance()
+                divisor = self._factor()
+                if divisor == 0:
+                    self.division_by_zero = True
+                    value = Fraction(0)
+                else:
+                    value /= divisor
+            else:
+                return value
+
+    def _factor(self) -> Fraction:
+        token = self._peek()
+        if token == "-":
+            self._advance()
+            return -self._factor()
+        if token == "(":
+            self._advance()
+            value = self._expr()
+            if self._peek() != ")":
+                raise _InvalidExpression
+            self._advance()
+            return value
+        if token is not None and "0" <= token[0] <= "9":
+            self._advance()
+            return Fraction(int(token))
+        raise _InvalidExpression
+
+
+def handle_calc(params: dict) -> tuple[int, dict]:
+    expr = params.get("expr")
+    if not isinstance(expr, str) or len(expr) > _MAX_EXPR_LENGTH:
+        return 400, {"error": "invalid expression"}
+    try:
+        parser = _Parser(_tokenize(expr))
+        value = parser.parse()
+    except _InvalidExpression:
+        return 400, {"error": "invalid expression"}
+    if parser.division_by_zero:
+        return 400, {"error": "division by zero"}
+    if value.denominator == 1:
+        return 200, {"result": value.numerator}
+    return 200, {"result": float(value)}
+
+
+def handle_get_user(params: dict) -> tuple[int, dict]:
+    raw = params.get("id")
+    if not isinstance(raw, str) or not raw.isdigit():
+        return 400, {"error": "invalid id"}
+    user = users.get_user(int(raw))
+    if user is None:
+        return 404, {"error": "not found"}
+    return 200, user
